name: lambdaplex-terminal
description: Trade Lambdaplex, Hedera's order-book exchange, from your own app: live books and trades over REST and WebSocket, Ed25519-signed orders from server routes, a TWAP bot that waits for settlement-final fills, and a verifiable track record on HCS indexed by an on-chain StrategyRegistry.

envVars.description: packages/nextjs/.env.local: Lambdaplex API key id (server only).
packages/nextjs/.env.local: the API key's Ed25519 private key (server only).
packages/nextjs/.env.local: set to true to allow order placement.
packages/nextjs/.env.local: ECDSA operator that publishes the HCS track record.
packages/nextjs/.env.local: that operator's private key (server only).
packages/nextjs/.env.local: HCS topic for the track record (yarn lambdaplex:topic:create).

steps.text: Market data needs no keys: start the app and open a market to see Lambdaplex's live book.
